title: HB1109 (67th Legislative Assembly (2021-2022)): Relating to the possession of a firearm or dangerous weapon at a public gathering.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (North Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, North Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official North Dakota text (INTRODUCED; official copy, https://ndlegis.gov/assembly/67-2021/regular/documents/21-0371-01000.pdf)
provenance.note: As introduced (21.0371.01000); no passage vote recorded. Whole of subsection 2 is reprinted in an amend-and-reenact; the text read has no strike/underline marks, so which exemptions are new could not be told. Subdivision (p) is quoted as the likely new part; other subdivisions (e.g. (n) storage in public housing, (o) school carry) may be new or old; check the page image.

operative_text: Section 1 (N.D.C.C. 62.1-02-05(2)(p)): An individual who is a paramedic or other emergency responder if the individual maintains the same level of firearms proficiency as is required by the peace officer standards and training board for law enforcement officers. A local law enforcement agency shall issue a certificate of compliance under this section to an individual who is proficient. Upon issuance of a certificate of compliance, the bureau of criminal investigation shall issue that individual an unrestricted concealed weapons license.
